statement: Pinned SDL constructs an Elite Xbox One default gamepad mapping with paddle1:b11, paddle2:b13, paddle3:b12 and paddle4:b14, while its Linux evdev backend maps present BTN_GRIPR/GRIPL/GRIPR2/GRIPL2 keys to right/left paddle slots and offers a compatibility fallback for legacy BTN_TRIGGER_HAPPY5 through BTN_TRIGGER_HAPPY8. Mapping definitions do not establish emitted evdev events or a particular runtime backend choice.

applicability.revision: Xbox Elite Series 2 model 1797, software-side revision at pinned sources
applicability.scope: SDL_gamepad.c:1329-1340; SDL_sysjoystick.c:2739-2795. Extra SDL gamepad slots are consumer policy, not device protocol proof.
